tool.name: Proteomiqon JoinQuantPepIonsWithProteins
tool.description: combines the results from ProteinInference and PSMBasedQuantification.
tool.command: #import re #set quant_basename = $re.sub(r'[^\w ,.\-+]','_',$quantifiedpeptides.element_identifier) ln -s '$quantifiedpeptides' '${quant_basename}.quant' && #set prot_basename = $re.sub(r'[^\w ,.\-+]','_',$inferredproteins.element_identifier) ln -s '$inferredproteins' '${prot_basename}.prot' && ln -s '$out_quantAndProt' '${quant_basename}.quantAndProt' && proteomiqon-joinquantpepionswithproteins -i '${quant_basename}.quant' -ii '${prot_basename}.prot' -o './'

validator.message: The metadatalist file must have at least 40 columns
The metadatalist file must have at least 5 columns

tool.help:
# What It Does
**Disclaimer** this tool needs the results from ProteinInference and PSMBasedQuantification.
Results from PSMBasedQuantification contain detailed information about the quantification of every peptide, but only basic informations about the protein they originated from. This information is obtained during the ProteinInference. This tool takes the results from both tools and combines the qauntification information of each peptide with the more accurate information about the corresponding protein including its q-value.
# Further Reading
Additional information about the tool can be found in the `documentation <https://csbiology.github.io/ProteomIQon/tools/JoinQuantPepIonsWithProteins.html>`_.
